note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS wording and the translator-rendered Old Testament verses the first edition carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse or passage, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…' (Ps 69:30-31, which the author runs together). Unmarked recitations count (1 Tim 2:4 'God wants all men to be saved', 1 John 4:4 'greater is He that is in you'). Speech inside a quotation is set in ‹ ›. Where the author's prose echoes a quoted word it follows OWB: Luke 18:1 'always to pray', Col 3:2 'set your minds', 2 Cor 4:4 'the god of this age … blinded the minds', Jude 1:20 'build yourselves up' (መገንባት), Rom 12:11 'never lag in zeal'.

`self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are allusions, bare citations, the author's own paraphrases and the closing prayer of salvation, plus Heb 11:1's second wording, which the author introduces as the ESV's to contrast with the first; OWB's wording stands in the first.
